summary: Published purchase-approval@0.2.0 reads an authoritative cost-center budget projection, records an approved ceiling with compare-and-set, and consumes the same bounded authority through an embedded mock-charge receipt-before-forward graph. The hosted registry reran both harness cases successfully; a separately signed full dogfood run proved budget version 1 to 2, balance 2200 to 1720, mock verification, sealing, and modeled forwarding without moving money.

signed_full_dogfood.scope: Post-publish full execution from the source profile; the hosted registry harness above independently binds the published package digests and reruns the same two cases.

decision.reason: The approved vendor request is within the 1000 USD cap, authoritative stored 2200 USD balance, exact requested scope, and matching mock provider price.

negative_proof.effect: No purchase.committed event and no mock-charge step execute because the agent decision remains unresolved before the human gate.

observations: Publisher q10283245 published exact package purchase-approval version 0.2.0 with package digest sha256:68d7540b7bc3e141e75c6043f9025afce30dc5322b801dea4c20a2c94e25e6e0 and profile digest sha256:98b7724ee7b368a8e50162879a39446ace0a516401010810d3cdff33b92c611b.
The caller no longer supplies current_budget_balance; read_projection keyed by cost_center and budget_period is authoritative.
The approved case read version 1 with 2200 USD remaining, emitted an exact 480 USD AttenuationRequest for Acme Hosting and purchase:hosting, and appended purchase.committed with expected_version 1.
The CAS append committed version 1 to 2 at budget_events:engineering-platform-dogfood:2; readback reported 480 committed and 1720 remaining.
Only after human confirmation and the CAS append did embedded mock-charge run price, challenge, verify, seal, and forward under the same parent payment authority.
The mock rail verified the mock settlement family and sealed receipt:charge:mock:acme-hosting-2026-07; it contacted no provider and moved no money.
The over-budget case requests 2800 USD against a 1500 USD cap and 1200 USD stored balance, stops at needs_agent, and never reaches budget append or charge.
